entities.summary: Caleb Jeffrey Hanie is an American former professional football player who was a quarterback in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Colorado State Rams and was signed by the Chicago Bears as an undrafted free agent in 2008. He was also a member of the Denver Broncos, Baltimore Ravens, Cleveland Browns, and Dallas Cowboys.
